mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.device_id, a.object_type, a.alarm_type, a.alarm_level, a.alarm_value::text AS alarm_value_json, a.status, a.occur_time, a.close_time, a.created_at FROM t_alarm AS a WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_alarm (device_id, object_type, alarm_type, alarm_level, alarm_value, status, occur_time) VALUES
(#{item.deviceId}, #{item.objectType}, #{item.alarmType}, #{item.alarmLevel}, #{item.alarmValueJson}::jsonb, 'PENDING', #{item.occurTime})

INSERT INTO t_alarm (device_id, object_type, alarm_type, alarm_level, alarm_value, status, occur_time, close_time) VALUES (#{alarm.deviceId}, #{alarm.objectType}, #{alarm.alarmType}, #{alarm.alarmLevel}, CAST(NULLIF(#{alarm.alarmValueJson}, '') AS jsonb), #{alarm.status}, now(), CASE WHEN #{alarm.status} = 'CLOSED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alarm SET device_id = #{alarm.deviceId}, object_type = #{alarm.objectType}, alarm_type = #{alarm.alarmType}, alarm_level = #{alarm.alarmLevel}, alarm_value = CAST(NULLIF(#{alarm.alarmValueJson}, '') AS jsonb), status = #{alarm.status}, close_time = CASE WHEN #{alarm.status} = 'CLOSED' THEN coalesce(close_time, now()) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{alarm.id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.device_id FROM t_alarm AS a WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND a.object_type = #{objectType}
